statement: Retain the existing PoBR generic preset selection: unique PoiseThreshold mode among BossHealthBar rows with MAP in exact Id, Xesht for pinnacle, and the same representative for Uber. These selectors are curated simulation compatibility, not a universal classification or claim that all bosses share this poise. All numeric values come from the selected target rows; no old-value gate or default. A tied or empty mode and a missing representative require an explicit selection decision.
